# Mining Specialist
1. Your direct superior is the Quartermaster.
2. Mining Specialists must deliver one ore bag full of ore [bold]each[/bold] before performing any other duties.
3. Mining Specialists are expected to be non-combatants, whose primary purpose is to collect ore via mining or the breaking down of salvaged components.
4. In situations that a Mining Specialist is on an expedition with the salvage team, they are to follow the Salvage Lead’s directives, and are considered subordinate to others on the salvage team.
5. Mining Specialists are expected to act according to the Salvage Specialist and Cargo Technician subsections when away from and on the station respectively.
